search_language.label: Search language
search_language.description: Preferred language for search results and channel pages. May affect video titles, descriptions and result order.

playback_quality.label: Max quality
playback_quality.description: Maximum video resolution. Auto lets mpv choose; Audio only turns off video. Applies when you start playback.

autoplay_recommendations.label: Continue with YouTube Mix
autoplay_recommendations.description: Prepare more videos while the last queued video plays. Use YouTube Mix when available, otherwise related videos. Manually queued videos keep the current suggestion source. Applies when starting playback or refreshing suggestions.

autoplay_count.label: Number of suggestions to queue
autoplay_count.description: How many suggestions to add at once (1–10). With 1, each suggested video generates the next. Higher values add a batch. Applies when starting playback or refreshing suggestions.

favorite_video_count.label: Videos per favorite channel
favorite_video_count.description: Latest videos to show per channel in Latest videos from favorites (1–20).

queue.title: Playback queue
queue.play_description: Play the queue in one mpv window. Played and skipped videos leave the queue; Previous returns to videos played in this session. Closing the player clears the queue and session history, keeping saved watch history.
queue.clear_confirm: Clear the queue and keep the current video?
queue.clear_description: Remove waiting videos and keep any current video playing. Automatic suggestions stop until you start playback or choose Refresh suggestions.
queue.read_error: Could not read the playback queue; existing data was preserved
queue.save_error: Could not save the playback queue
queue.helper_unavailable: Queue playback requires python3 and the queue helper
queue.sync_error: Queue saved, but the active player could not be updated
queue.reset_confirm: Back up and reset the unreadable queue?
queue.reset_description: Back up the queue file and create an empty queue. Watch later, watch history and favorite channels are kept.
queue.reset_done: Queue reset; original file backed up
queue.backup_error: Could not back up the queue; original file was preserved
queue.refresh_description: Replace waiting suggestions using the current source video. Keep manually queued videos and resume automatic suggestions.
queue.refresh_error: Could not refresh suggestions; open a video and try again
queue.video_failed: Could not play a queued video; it was skipped. If the queue is empty, open a video to continue.

cache.confirm_hint: Images will download again as needed. Saved videos, watch history and favorite channels are kept.

url.invalid: Enter a supported YouTube video link

error.search_limit: yt-dlp response exceeded the output limit
error.library_read: Could not read the YouTube library; existing data was preserved
error.library_save: Could not save the YouTube library
error.cache_remove: Could not remove some cached thumbnails
error.progress_clear: Could not clear saved playback positions. Watch history was kept.
error.history_clear: Could not clear watch history data. Watch history was kept.
error.search_helper: Search requires python3 and the bundled search helper

status.channel_search_hint: Type to search in this channel

history.confirm_hint: Delete watch history, saved playback positions and channel play counts. Watch later, favorite channels and the queue are kept.

autoplay.failed: Could not load YouTube suggestions. Use Refresh suggestions to try again.
autoplay.network_failed: Could not connect to YouTube for suggestions after retrying. Use Refresh suggestions to try again.
autoplay.empty: No new suggestions are available for this video. Open another video or add videos manually.

later.confirm_hint: Watch history, favorite channels and the queue are kept.

favorites.confirm_hint: Watch later, watch history and the queue are kept.

library.reset_confirm: Back up and reset the unreadable library?
library.reset_description: Back up the original file, then clear Watch later, watch history and favorite channels. Playback positions and the queue are kept.
library.backup_error: Could not back up the library; original file was preserved
library.reset_done: Library reset; original file backed up
